header.title: What is a Telegram mini-app and how to launch it without coding
header.lead: A Telegram mini-app is a web service living inside the messenger that grants companies instant, convenient access to their audience. Let's see how these experiences work, when they shine and how to launch your own no-code product with the Unitee Space platform.

intro.imageAlt: Telegram mini-app — a new generation of the web
intro.imageCaption: Telegram mini-app: a new generation of web experiences
intro.paragraph1: Telegram mini-apps are compact yet powerful web services that run directly inside the messenger. You can order food, book tickets, take a course or play games — without leaving the chat window.
intro.paragraph2: Unlike classic mobile apps they do not take storage space and require no installation. The user opens a Telegram mini-app, authenticates in two taps and instantly receives the needed functionality. For brands this means a fast launch without complex store approvals and with minimal support.
intro.paragraph3: Thanks to visual builders and ready-made integrations you can create a mini-app today without a development team: drag-and-drop the interface and connect key services automatically — exactly the approach offered by Unitee Space.

howItWorks.title: How do Telegram mini-apps work?
howItWorks.overview: Mini-apps open in Web App mode and rely on standard web technologies — HTML, CSS, JavaScript. All interactions go through the Telegram API: the interface stays consistent on mobile and desktop while authentication, payments and notifications remain inside the secure messenger ecosystem.
howItWorks.buildersParagraph: Modern platforms provide templates and visual editors. Choose a structure, drop in your content and connect a bot in minutes. A builder like Unitee lets you focus on the user experience instead of the tech.
howItWorks.buildersImageCaption: Admin panel for Telegram mini-apps powered by Unitee
howItWorks.apiParagraph: Through the API a mini-app receives user data (with consent), connects payments and integrates with external services. Flows are personalised and communication is automated.
howItWorks.comfortParagraph: Mini-apps run inside Telegram's secure infrastructure: data never leaves the messenger and sessions use a verified account. Users stay in a familiar environment and businesses rely on built-in authentication and notification tools.

howTo.title: Build a Telegram mini-app without code: 5 steps
howTo.overview: Follow a simple plan: pick a platform, assemble the interface, connect the bot and test your journeys. Here are the essential steps with Unitee Space and other popular solutions.
howTo.step1Paragraph: Tools such as Tars, ManyChat, Chatfuel or Landbot include visual editors with ready-made blocks. Teams that want full control choose Unitee Space: the platform combines a powerful builder, built-in analytics and flexible no-code logic.
howTo.step1ImageAlt: Share Telegram mini-apps and the TON token
howTo.step1ImageCaption: Share your mini-apps inside Telegram and across the TON ecosystem
howTo.step2Paragraph: Buttons, forms, product cards — everything is customised via drag-and-drop. Plan the actions: signup, request, payment. In the Unitee builder every block adapts to mobile and reflects your identity.
howTo.step3Paragraph: Connect the bot via BotFather and link your flows to the needed webhooks. In a mini-app you add payments, notifications and personalised recommendations. Unitee Space issues secure tokens automatically and guides your integration tests.
howTo.step3ImageAlt: A Telegram mini-app is a web application
howTo.step3ImageCaption: A Telegram mini-app is still a web application
howTo.step4Paragraph: Check behaviour on different devices and networks. A polished Telegram mini-app loads fast, renders forms correctly and sends notifications instantly. Unitee Space provides staging environments and launch checklists.
howTo.step5Paragraph: After launch, activate campaigns, add the mini-app to the catalog and offer a home-screen shortcut. Use built-in analytics and monetisation tools to measure conversion and evolve the product.

benefits.title: Benefits and capabilities of Telegram mini-apps
benefits.introImageAlt: Telegram platform — the peak of web technology
benefits.introImageCaption: The Telegram platform: a cutting-edge playground for the web
benefits.businessImageCaption: Telegram has grown continuously since launch
benefits.businessParagraph: Companies use Telegram mini-apps to boost sales, automate service and capture data. API features let you sell products, run surveys, launch loyalty programs and integrate with a CRM.
businessList: Sell products and services directly inside the messenger.
Automate customer service and feedback collection.
Launch surveys, forms and personalised journeys.
Create loyalty programs and referral mechanics.
Connect a CRM to process orders and payments.
benefits.comfortParagraph: No app to download, automatic updates and an interface that mirrors chat patterns. A Telegram mini-app launches instantly and works on any device with Telegram.
benefits.botsImageAlt: Unitee — a builder for beginners and experts
benefits.botsImageCaption: Unitee: a builder for both beginners and experts
benefits.botsParagraph: Mini-apps rely on bots to take orders, send reminders, onboard clients and deliver personalised campaigns. They also connect to external systems: CRMs, payment providers and cloud databases.
benefits.savingsParagraph: A traditional mobile app demands a large go-to-market budget and recurring updates. A Telegram mini-app dramatically cuts those costs: the visual builder lets the team update content and features without hiring developers.

examples.title: High-performing Telegram mini-apps
examples.introImageCaption: Over 300,000 users already rely on Unitee mini-apps
examples.commerceParagraph: Stores build their catalogues in a mini-app, manage carts and accept payments through built-in gateways. Customers stay inside the chat and the business skips native development.
commerceList: Convenience: the purchase happens in a single window.
Efficiency: no store fees or complex maintenance.
examples.servicesParagraph: Restaurants, salons and hotels automate bookings, deposits and notifications. Customers pick a service, pay the reservation and receive reminders — everything inside the Telegram mini-app.
examples.gamesParagraph: Brands design quizzes, quests and interactive contests. Gamification boosts engagement and unlocks monetisation models such as subscriptions, paid perks or partnerships.
examples.coworkingParagraph: Inside a workspace a Telegram mini-app becomes the main hub: room booking, service payments, loyalty programs and integration with the CRM.
examples.educationParagraph: Teams launch online courses, assessments and simulators. Content adapts to each level and progress is tracked in analytics. Tutors monitor learner activity and update materials quickly.

future.automationParagraph: More companies move ordering, support and delivery into a mini-app. Builder templates adapt to every industry while data feeds CRMs and analytics.

future.smartCityParagraph: City services digitise requests, parking payments and communication with residents. A Telegram mini-app becomes the entry point to track cases and receive personalised recommendations.

future.educationImageCaption: Your teams or audience learn directly inside a mini-app
future.educationParagraph: Mini-apps enable personalised learning paths, assessments and gamification. Unitee Space handles broadcasts, adaptive lessons and analytics for tutors.
future.gamificationImageCaption: Gamification boosts engagement inside a Telegram mini-app
future.gamificationParagraph: Telegram keeps expanding playful mechanics. Brands use mini-apps to retain, reward and activate communities while opening new monetisation channels.

conclusion.title: In short
conclusion.paragraph1: A Telegram mini-app is an effective way to launch a digital service without building native apps. Updates deploy instantly, users can pin a shortcut to the home screen and customer data remains protected.
conclusion.paragraph2: With the Unitee Space platform companies get the full toolkit: a visual builder, embedded analytics, monetisation tools and CRM integrations. Launches speed up, performance stays under control and the Telegram ecosystem keeps expanding.
